summary: Iteration 29: frontend-only retest of the offline Playgama build at /pgtest/index.html. The build is from 14:43:16, after the CatchCard.js edit at 14:42:57, and the bundle contains the new toast in catch-sell-btn and catch-double-gold-btn. Tested at 1920x1080 in fresh contexts with seeded saves. FIX VERIFIED: seeded stats.sold=99 (pg_seed28b), caught a fish and pressed catch-sell-btn. The toasts were exactly ['Achievement unlocked: Market Regular', 'Sold for 86 gold'], each once. After a reload the save has sold_100 in ach, gold 11026 and pearls 32. REGRESSION OK: (a) the catch popup showed with 'Quest complete: Casting Off | +60 gold · +40 XP · +2 Pearls' and 'Achievement unlocked: First Blood' once each. With seed28b, the first cast showed 'Quest complete: Patience', 'Comfortable' and 'Something Special' once each. (b) A full contract hand-in with contracts.total=9 showed 'Achievement unlocked: Reliable Hands' x1, plus the Honest Work quest toast and the 'Contract filled for Nettie' toast. Total became 10 and contracts_10 is in the save. (c) There were no /api/ requests to the app origin. The only /api/ calls went to api.playgama.com bridge timestamp and analytics, which are SDK calls. There were 0 page errors.

integration_issues.flow: tfl Fishing page catch-sell-button (code review only, not exercised in the world build)
integration_issues.issue: tfl/pages/game/Fishing.js:75 posts to /inventory/sell but does not toast data.new_achievements. The api.js:32 interceptor still skips /inventory/sell, so achievements are silent offline if this page is reachable. LOW.

issues: The CatchCard achievement toast has no reward description (e.g. '+500 gold · +1 Pearl'). The interceptor and other paths show one. This is a minor inconsistency.

action_items: Optional (LOW): toast new_achievements in tfl/pages/game/Fishing.js catch-sell-button too, or switch to sonner toast ids ('ach-'+id) and drop the URL exclusion in tfl/lib/api.js:32.
Optional (LOW): add the reward description to the CatchCard achievement toast to match the interceptor.
critical_code_review_comments: tfl/lib/api.js:32: the URL-regex exclusion is still fragile. Every new caller of /inventory/sell or /contracts/ must remember to toast achievements itself. A sonner id per achievement would de-dupe every path at once.
seed_data_creation: Browser-local saves only, via pg_seed28b.js (sold 99) and pg_seed.js + pg_seed28.js (contracts total 9).
context_for_next_testing_agent: In browser_automation, exec the helpers with exec(open(f).read(), g) where g=globals(), and call them as g['boot'] etc. A plain exec puts the functions out of scope. For the seed28b flow: boot, skip_tut, open the quests and contracts spots, run the seed, reload, OBS, to_millbrook, then fish_until_catch. After a reload the player is at the harbour, so open contracts directly with open_spot.
rca of the issue: Iteration 28 silent achievement: fixed by toasting data.new_achievements in CatchCard.js sell() and sellDouble(). Verified in the browser.
